title: mobile.de Car Search Scraper
description: Search mobile.de car listings with vehicle titles, makes, models, prices, mileage, registration, images, and listing links. Batch searches and filter stock by price, age, or mileage.

batch.title: Vehicle searches
batch.description: Free-text vehicle queries for mobile.de car listings.
batch.valueDescription: query used to search mobile.de inventory.

schema.description: Validated marketplace model identifier. Requires make_id.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search mobile.de cars by query and filters for make, model, price, mileage, registration, and links. Batch searches and export vehicle inventory.
storeCopy.intro: Search mobile.de for cars by keyword and available filters. Export vehicle titles, make and model, price, mileage, registration details, images, and listing identifiers.
useCases: Car buyers can compare listings by model, price, year, and mileage.
Dealers can monitor comparable stock for selected makes and models.
Automotive analysts can collect marketplace inventory for pricing studies.
howToUse: Add a vehicle query to `searches` for each search.
Set optional price, registration-year, mileage, make, or model filters.
Choose the page size and result cap, then export matching car rows.

faqs.question: Can I search vehicles other than cars?
faqs.answer: The current mobile.de v1 search accepts car inventory. Choose car as the vehicle type or leave the default.
